enrollment_source: Arizona Community Colleges Strategic Vision 2025 Student Progress and Outcomes Data (statewide unduplicated 12-month headcount)
notes: Statewide unduplicated 12-month headcount across county community college districts (not Fall-term-only). Companion statewide FTSE for 2023-24 was 93,777 (AZ Auditor General / Strategic Vision).

enrollment_source: California Community Colleges Chancellor's Office Fall 2023 Enrollment Memo (May 17, 2024)
notes: Systemwide Fall term headcount (116 colleges). CCCCO State of the System also reports annual 2023-24 enrollment >2.1 million students (academic-year unduplicated).

enrollment_source: Association of Florida Colleges (myafc.org) — Florida College System impact stats; Division of Florida Colleges / FDOE CCTCMIS Fact Book historically reports annual & Fall headcount
notes: Headcount (not FTE). FCS official estimating conferences primarily publish FTE: final FY 2023-24 system FTE was 284,140.6 (EDR Education Estimating Conference, Aug 9, 2024). Wikipedia/FDOE 2022 Fact Book cited ~640,183 students for an earlier year; AFC currently lists ~614,000 enrolled per year. Most FCS colleges are IPEDS-classified as 4-year (baccalaureate), so NCES Digest 'public 2-year' undercounts Florida. florida_street/florida_zip: Division of Florida Colleges / FLDOE Turlington Building.

enrollment_source: SUNY Office of Institutional Research Fall 2024 Enrollment (Nov 2024) + NYSED Higher Education Enrollment Data Fall 2024 (CUNY 2-year)
notes: Combined CC-relevant: SUNY community colleges 165,229 (SUNY IR Fall 2024) + CUNY community colleges (NYSED CUNY 2-YEAR undergraduates) 74,636 = 239,865. CUNY is a separate system from SUNY. NYSED SUNY 2-YEAR alone is 160,677 (definitional differences vs SUNY IR, e.g., FIT). Prefer SUNY IR for SUNY CC sector total.

enrollment_source: NCCCS State Board Strategic Plan Annual Report / PLAN-02 (Student Headcount Enrollment KPI)
notes: Unduplicated Fall semester headcount across all academic levels (curriculum + continuing education + basic skills) at 58 colleges. Fall 2023 was 393,227 per NCCCS news / State Board materials.

enrollment_source: Ohio Association of Community Colleges Quick Facts / Policy Agenda (data updated December 2024; sources include ODHE)
notes: OACC reports 200,000+ for-credit students annually plus ~40,000 non-credit. ODHE HEI Fall 2022 certified community-college sector headcount was 169,643 (institution unduplicated). OACC/NSC press cited ~6.4% Fall 2024 YoY growth for Ohio CCs; accessible Fall 2024 sector absolute total not confirmed in this pass.

enrollment_source: Oregon Higher Education Coordinating Commission (HECC) Fall 4th-week enrollment, reported by Oregon Community College Association (Nov 15, 2024)
notes: Statewide community college 4th-week Fall headcount; FTE was 21,897 (+7% YoY). OCCA also cites 200,573 statewide student headcount for academic year 2023-24 (includes non-credit).

enrollment_source: Pennsylvania Commission for Community Colleges (PACCC) FY 2026-27 budget / sector press materials
notes: 15 public community colleges. PACCC reports 264,000 enrollment for AY 2024-25; same materials also cite 221,382 credit and non-credit students served (metric wording differs). Not a single Fall census figure; PA SBHE dashboard uses IPEDS credit enrollment by institution type.

enrollment_source: SC Technical College System opening Fall headcount (via Midlands Technical College Fact Book SCTCS comparison table; Fall 2023 confirmed in SC CHE 2024 Statistical Abstract)
notes: Systemwide opening Fall headcount for 16 technical colleges. Fall 2023 was 78,847 (SC Commission on Higher Education Statistical Abstract 2024).

enrollment_source: Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board (THECB) Preliminary Fall 2024 Enrollment (IDEA Committee, Oct 23, 2024); TACC Fact Sheet 2025 (~700,000)
notes: THECB preliminary community-college headcount 701,766 (+5.4% from Fall 2023 certified 665,565). Excludes TSTC and Lamar State Colleges. TACC member preliminary report (45 colleges) totaled 562,739.

enrollment_source: Washington State Board for Community and Technical Colleges (SBCTC) Research Brief 25-1: Fall 2024 Enrollment (also ERIC ED677520)
notes: Systemwide CTC Fall quarter headcount; +6% YoY from Fall 2023 (180,947). Fall 2024 FTES was 142,070 (+8%).
